hardware.notes: LCD BSP variant A (hwspi-rgb888). Same unit used for the B validation record bsp-0.4.0-20260730-01.

lcd.observed: A hwspi-rgb888 boot identity matched commit e2d53ad. SPI1 25 MHz RGB888 initialization completed. Black, white, red, green and blue solid fills all matched RAMRD readback with zero mismatches. The 2x2 red/green/blue/white pattern also matched with zero mismatches and app_status=pass. The operator photo shows the expected green top band, blue bottom band, white frame and RGB squares.

sd.observed: detect=present, init ok, and mount/write/sync/close/read/compare/close/remove completed with result_stage=ok. The LCD status region was green.

keyboard.observed: The run recorded 148 key events: 74 pressed and 74 released events, including numeric, alphabetic, symbol and special-key codes. The final event counts were pressed_count=74 and released_count=74.

notes: A LCD, SD and keyboard tests pass on the same PicoCalc unit used for the B LCD/SD validation. overall_status remains pending until board_revision and SD-card identification are recorded.
